mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.1%) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated unemployment rates above 6.0% signal a weak labor market and slowing economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 6.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in housing starts and retail sales above their 3-month moving averages indicate robust consumer demand, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both above their 3-month moving averages
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST and RSAFS both exceed their 3-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: A supply expansion regime characterized by industrial production above 105 (index 2017=100) signals strong manufacturing output, boosting corporate profits and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 105.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 above 18700 billion) reflects robust economic activity, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 exceeds 18700 billion.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL above 260) indicates potential monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 260.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market, defined by rising payrolls and falling unemployment, signals improving economic conditions and positive corporate earnings momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS is rising and UNRATE is falling.

mechanism_narrative: In a very low interest rate regime (FEDFUNDS below 0.5%), monetary policy remains highly accommodative, reducing borrowing costs and supporting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.
